subject: Special HW subclass + overage credit request — GraniteAI
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@granite.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GraniteAI - special HW subclass & billing ask (initial request)

Folks — looping you in on an ask from GraniteAI (Samira on cc). Short background: they are scoping a high-throughput inference rollout for a new vision model and want a Dedicated capacity footprint that prioritizes H100 availability with preemption protection during business hours. They are asking for three non-standard items as part of the committed capacity discussion: 

1) A temporary reservation hold for 60 days while they finalize funding (so we don’t release capacity).
2) Guaranteed availability on H100 family for the first 6 months, with fallback to A100 only if latency degrade <10%.
3) A one-time overage credit (they requested 30% of expected overage for the first 2 months) plus a discounted overage rate for the first quarter.

Customer justification: Granite expects a 9-figure ARR trajectory in 18 months if the pilot scales. They’ve committed to a 12-month Dedicated term but need the flexibility during the pilot and the explicit H100 affinity. I attached their requirements doc and an internal usage snapshot Samira shared.

As this is outside standard reservation and pricing terms, they asked me to escalate for executive approval on the hardware guarantee and the billing concession. Can Sales Ops / Finance / Infra weigh in on constraints and an approval path? Specific asks: 
- Can we offer a 60d reservation hold?
- Are we able to commit to H100 with preemption protection, or do we require a fallback policy?
- What level of overage credit/discount is approvable from Finance?

Next steps: if you agree, I’ll add a line in HubSpot and send a conditional SOW draft for Legal.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: Granite_Requirements_v3.pdf; Granite_HubSpot_Usage_Snapshot.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GraniteAI - special HW subclass & billing ask (clarifying details)

Jonas — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the usage snapshot. A couple of clarifying questions before we route to Exec: 

1) ARR / committed spend: you note a 12-month Dedicated term — what is the committed spend number (ARR or committed $)? we need that to size risk.
2) Failure / fallback mechanics: if we only offer A100 fallback with a promised latency SLA (<10% degradation), we need explicit SLO language and an automatic routing policy defined (region, model size, seq len). Does the customer accept automatic fallbacks outside business hours?
3) Reservation hold: operationally we can place a 30–45 day soft hold; 60 days is heavy unless legal signs a deposit or a short-term invoice. Any chance they can move to 45 days?

I’m pinging Finance (Vanessa) and Infra (Aditya) to give cost/operational impact. I’m also attaching a proposed conditional language snippet (internal template) for the SOW so Legal has a starting point.

If you can respond to 1–3 with numbers, I’ll draft the internal ask for Lauren to present at the Deal Desk review.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GraniteAI - special HW subclass & billing ask (finance input)

Thanks Mark / Jonas — I pulled cost runs and stress-tested the proposed concessions. Summary of finance view: 

- Committed spend: customer has indicated ~$420k MRR expected at scale; initial committed Dedicated term estimate in HubSpot is $1.2M for 12 months (still needs formal PO).
- Reservation hold: we can support up to 45 days without cash security; 60 days requires a deposit equal to one month’s committed spend or a non-refundable booking fee.
- H100 guarantee: operationally expensive; if we hold H100 exclusively, incremental hardware cost and opportunity cost are material. Finance recommends approving a conditional H100 affinity (best-effort with preemption protection during business hours) but with fallback SLA and a higher fallback priority for the customer.
- Overage credit / discount: approving a 30% overage credit is outside standard policy. Finance recommends a one-time overage credit equal to 20% of the forecasted overage for the first billing period and a discounted overage rate of 15% (vs list) for the first 60 days, conditional on receiving the signed PO and a 12-month commit.

Recommend next steps: request Exec approval for "Reservation hold up to 45 days + H100 affinity (best-effort) + one-time 20% overage credit + 15% overage rate discount for 60 days". Any approval beyond these terms requires VP-level signoff.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: Finance_Runbook_GraniteAI.xlsx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@granite.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GraniteAI - special HW subclass & billing ask (requesting VP signoff)

Aditya — I’m escalating this to you for final infra/exec signoff. Quick summary for decision: 

What we want to approve (recommended by Sales & Finance):
- Reservation hold: 45 days (no deposit)
- H100 affinity: best-effort with preemption protection during business hours; explicit fallback to A100 with automatic routing and <10% latency degradation target
- Billing concession: one-time 20% overage credit for customer’s first billing cycle and a temporary 15% discount to overage rates for 60 days (contingent on signed PO and 12mo commit)

Customer asks we are declining / pushing back on:
- 60 day hold without deposit (Finance said no)
- 30% overage credit (Finance recommends 20%)
- Full exclusive H100 guarantee (operationally risky)

Business case: projected $1.2M committed spend (12mo term), strategic fit (vision product that could become platform-level customer). Haas: they’re time-sensitive; they want the hold in place by May 20 to avoid losing the pool.

Can you confirm approval for the recommended package? If yes I’ll update HubSpot, route SOW to Legal, and send a conditional offer to Samira. If you want a higher allowance for the overage credit or longer hold we’ll need a written Exec exception and Legal to scope deposit language.

Thanks,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
VP, Global Sales — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GraniteAI - special HW subclass & billing ask (final signoff)

Thanks Lauren — I reviewed the ask. Approve the following limited exceptions with conditions: 

1) Reservation hold: APPROVED up to 45 days (no additional deposit). If customer requests an extension beyond 45 days, require a deposit equal to one month’s committed spend.

2) H100 affinity: APPROVED as a "best-effort H100 affinity with preemption protection during business hours". We will publish automatic fallback to A100 with an objective to keep latency degradation <10%. Operations must implement the routing policy and monitoring dashboard; Aditya/Infra team to confirm by EOD May 18.

3) Billing concession: APPROVED a one-time overage credit equal to 20% of the forecasted first-cycle overage and a 15% temporary discount on overage rates for 60 days. No further discounting approved.

Conditions: 
- Signed PO and 12-month committed term required before we start the reservation hold.
- Legal must add a short addendum to the MSA to capture the deposit / hold mechanics, fallback routing, and monitoring SLA. I’ve CC'd Legal — please draft a 1-pager addendum referencing deal_id GRN-202705-12345.
- Sales Ops (Markus) to update HubSpot and Procurement link before customer notification.

Jonas — you have approval to communicate the conditional terms to Samira and move the SOW to Legal. Please make the offer explicit about conditions and timeline.

Aditya Rao
VP, Infrastructure & Product Ops
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: SOW-Draft-Granite.docx; Finance_Runbook_GraniteAI.xlsx
